Definition: from G3844 and G3049; to misreckon, i.e. delude:--beguile, deceive.
BiblicalUsage: Paralogizomai means to misreckon, to delude, to beguile with false reasoning. James says be ye doers of the word and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves, and Paul says he speaks so that no man should beguile you with enticing words.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that self-deception is the quietest sin: I can hear the word every week and still deceive myself, if I never do it.
